annotations.title: Check email authentication and site security

description: Checks whether a domain's email is likely to reach the inbox (SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, mail servers) and whether the website has basic security in place (HTTPS, security headers, WordPress exposure, Lovable/Supabase setup). Reads only public DNS records and the public home page. The report is written in Portuguese.

url.description: Public address of the site to check, e.g. 'example.com' or 'https://example.com'.

name: check_site_email_security
title: Check email authentication and site security
